intro.title: Session Timeout Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom React hook that tracks user activity and automatically logs them out after a period of inactivity. You will learn to use the useState and useEffect hooks to manage a timer and listen for user events like mouse movements and key presses. The main technologies involved are React, TypeScript for type safety, and the browser's native event listeners. By the end, you'll have a reusable hook that can help secure applications by managing session timeouts.
intro.usecase: Session timeout hooks are essential for security and user experience in applications that handle sensitive data or require authentication. You'll see this pattern in banking dashboards that automatically log users out after inactivity to prevent unauthorized access, e-commerce checkout pages that preserve cart data while warning about session expiration, and admin panels for content management systems. As a developer, implementing this hook ensures compliance with security standards while providing clear visual feedback to users through countdown timers or modal warnings before their session expires.
